svg.title: Cecil waits beside a finished bundle while Riju searches for staples.
svg.desc: On the quiet halt platform, Cecil's verified stack is ready, but an old stapler is empty. Riju searches his form satchel while the robot waits with its stamp arm extended.
svg.text: Page 22, panel 4 · Low medium shot across a temporary sorting table on the halt platform

text.tspan: Cecil outruns the paper handling and waits while
Riju searches his satchel for staples.
